title: Super Robot Taisen F
native_title: スーパー・ロボット大戦Ｆ
overview:
Justice is in our hands! Super Robots, a battle of the soul!!

Super Robot Taisen F is a strategy RPG that gathers giant robots from many anime series into one war, from the classic Mazinger Z to Neon Genesis Evangelion, alongside Gundam, Getter Robo, Combattler V, Daitarn 3 and more.

You and the enemy take turns moving units across the battle map. When two units clash, the fight plays out as an animated battle scene with the pilots shouting their lines. Each pilot has a set of Spirit Commands, special abilities that can turn a battle around. Between scenarios, story dialogue moves the plot forward and you can upgrade your robots and pilots before the next fight.

- Robots and pilots from a wide range of anime series
- Animated battle scenes and Spirit Commands
- Memory backup saves

正義は我が手に！
スーパーロボット、魂の戦い!!
